remarks: Located on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the heart of Darien, this 3-bedroom, 1-bath home features a recently renovated kitchen, brand-new recessed lighting, and a spacious finished basement perfect for a home office, a home gym, or a second TV room. The level lot offers plenty of outdoor space, and there's ample parking in the driveway. Enjoy unbeatable convenience-just minutes from Darien Train Station, I-95, downtown Darien, Tilley Pond park, and top local spots like Trader Joe's, Ten Twenty Post, and Scena Wine Bar. A rare rental opportunity in a prime location! Tenants are responsible for all utilities, trash/recycling, landscaping, and snow removal.
